parts.name: AvatarRoot
parts.description: Holds the picture's loading status and shares it with the image and fallback inside it. Size and shape the avatar on this element. Avatars in a list that comes from a server can be removed by a new answer at any time.

parts.name: AvatarImage
parts.description: The picture. Its source is loaded off-screen first, and the `` is added only once it has loaded, so a broken image never shows. With `loading="lazy"`, the request starts when the avatar approaches the viewport.

props.name: src
props.description: The picture's URL. Without `src` or `srcset` the fallback shows.

props.name: srcset
props.description: Candidate sources for the picture, as on an ``.

props.name: crossorigin
props.description: The CORS mode for loading the picture, as on an ``.

props.name: referrerpolicy
props.description: The referrer policy for loading the picture, as on an ``.

props.name: onLoadingStatusChange
props.description: Called with `"loading"`, then `"loaded"` or `"error"`, each time the source is loaded. It is called from an effect, after the status has changed on screen.

dataAttributes.name: data-ending-style
dataAttributes.description: Present while the `` animates out because a new source started loading. It is removed when its transitions end.

dataAttributes.name: data-starting-style
dataAttributes.description: Present for the first frame after the `` appears: style the state it animates in from.

parts.name: AvatarFallback
parts.description: Shown while the picture hasn't loaded: while it loads, when it fails, and when there is none. Usually initials or an icon.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long to wait before showing the fallback, in ms, so a picture that loads quickly doesn't flash it first.
